BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Inventory.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Inventory Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Inventory management DDD domain: StockItems per product, StockLocations for warehouses, StockMovements for audit trail, StockReservations for order holds, and aggregate Stock state with availability validation.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: Evans DDD · Event Sourcing on Movements

Principle.name: Immutable Movement History
Principle.Description: Stock movements are append-only events; the current stock is derived from movement summation.
Principle.Rationale: Provides complete audit trail; prevents data tampering.

Principle.name: Reservation Expiry
Principle.Description: Stock reservations have configurable expiry; expired reservations are automatically released back to available stock.
Principle.Rationale: Prevents abandoned carts from blocking real inventory.

Principle.name: Multi-Location Stock
Principle.Description: Stock is tracked per location; availability checks consider location proximity and default location settings.
Principle.Rationale: Enables multi-warehouse fulfillment and location-aware stock display.

Feature.name: Stock Items
Feature.Description: Per-product-variant stock tracking with quantities and location assignments.

Feature.name: Stock Movements
Feature.Description: Append-only movement audit trail with reason codes (receiving, shipping, adjustment, transfer).

Feature.name: Stock Reservations
Feature.Description: Order-placed stock holds with expiry and auto-release.

Feature.name: Stock Locations
Feature.Description: Warehouse/location management with default location flag.

Feature.name: Availability Validation
Feature.Description: Real-time stock availability check across locations.

Abstraction.name: StockItem
Abstraction.Description: Per-product-variant stock with quantities, location assignments, and availability state.

Abstraction.name: StockLocation
Abstraction.Description: Warehouse location with address, contact info, and default flag.
Abstraction.Purpose: Physical storage location for stock items.

Abstraction.name: StockMovement
Abstraction.Description: Append-only movement record with reason code and quantity delta.
Abstraction.Purpose: Complete audit trail for stock changes.

Abstraction.name: StockReservation
Abstraction.Description: Order-placed stock hold with expiry and auto-release capability.

Abstraction.name: AvailabilityValidator
Abstraction.Description: Validates stock availability across locations for order fulfillment.
Abstraction.Purpose: Real-time availability checks before order confirmation.

AntiPattern.name: Editing Movement History
AntiPattern.Avoid: Modifying or deleting stock movement records.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Create a compensating adjustment movement for corrections.

AntiPattern.name: Reservation Without Expiry
AntiPattern.Avoid: Creating perpetual reservations that never expire.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always set an expiry; configure auto-release for expired reservations.
